MS. JUSTICE NEENA BANSAL KRISHNA  ORDER % 14.06.2024 I.As. 31727/2024, 31726/2024 (Exemptions)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The applications are disposed of.

The present Petition under Section 9 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 has been filed on behalf of the petitioners seeking the following prayers: -
"a. Pass an Order restraining the Respondent No.1 and his GPA holders, officials,
employees, agents, servants, assigns, representative or anyone claiming through and under him, etc. from creating the third-party interest or interfering in the possession of the Petitioners or altering the status of possession in respect of Subject Property bearing Plot B-1/48, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi - 110017, ad measuring 223 Sq. Yards in any manner whatsoever till the final adjudication of disputes between the parties;
This is a digitally signed order.

The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal Arun Vohra & Ors vs Harish Kumar & Ors on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111515131/

sentences.text: The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 17/06/2024 at 20:43:40 b.

Pass an Order restraining Respondent Nos. 2 and 3 and their GPA holders, officials, employees, agents, servants, assigns,
representative or anyone claiming through them, etc. from entering into third floor of the Subject Property bearing Plot B- 1/48, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi-110017, ad measuring 223 Sq. Yards till the final adjudication of disputes between the parties; c.
Pass an Order retraining Respondent Nos. 4 and 5 and their GPA holders, officials,
employees, agents, servants, assigns, representative or anyone claiming through them, etc. from representing themselves as Owners of the second floor and from altering status of possession of the Subject Property bearing Plot B-1/48, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi - 110017, ad measuring 223 Sq. Yards;

d. Pass an ex-parte, ad-interim reliefs in favour of the Petitioners and against the Respondents in terms of Prayer clause (a) to (c) of the Present Petition."
4. Learned counsel for the respondent No. 1, who is appearing on advance Notice, submits that the respondent No. 1 has a right to the third floor of the Property No. Plot B-1/48, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi-110017 under the Collaboration Agreement.
5.

It is submitted on behalf of the petitioners that apparently, the respondent No. a has sold the third floor of the Property No. Plot B-1/48, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi-110017 to the respondent No.
2 and thereafter, to the respondent No. 3 and an FIR No. 0142/2024 under Sections 420/406 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 has been registered at Police Station Malviya Nagar against the respondent No. 1 in respect of sale of the third floor of the Property No. Plot B-1/48, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi-110017.
6.

It is further submitted on behalf of the petitioners that the Basement, ground and first floor of the Property No. Plot B-1/48, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi-110017 are in possession of the petitioners which is in accordance This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 17/06/2024 at 20:43:40 with the Collaboration Agreement.

The dispute which is being now raised is in respect of the second floor, to which the petitioners are claiming a Title as well as possession, but it is fairly conceded that the second floor of the Property No. Plot B-1/48, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi-110017 is lying locked and the keys of the same are not in possession with the petitioners.

7. Learned counsel on behalf of the petitioners also submits that the keys of the second floor of the Property No. Plot B-1/48, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi-110017 are in possession with the respondent Nos. 4 and 5 who have purchased the second floor through respondent No. 1, the Builder through Agreement to Sell and the possession of the same has also been taken over by them in March, 2024.

8. Learned counsel for the respondent No. 1, on instructions, submits that the second floor of the Property No. Plot B-1/48, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi-110017 has not been sold to respondent Nos. 4 Arun Vohra & Ors vs Harish Kumar & Ors on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111515131/
2 and 5 and no Agreement to Sell in this regard has been executed nor any possession has been handed over to them.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 9. In view of the submissions made, the parties are directed to maintain the status quo vis-a-vis., the Title and Possession of the Property No. Plot B- 1/48, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi-110017, till further orders.
10. Reply be filed within 15 days with a copy to opposite counsel.

11. List before the Roster Bench on 09.07.2024.
NEENA BANSAL KRISHNA (VACATION JUDGE) JUNE 14, 2024 S.Sharma
